about_the_game:
Skibi’s Castle TD 2 is a sticker-boardgame tower defense sequel to the classic Warcraft III mod.

Rydik’s been beaten… but now new invaders have arrived, and they’re not just angry. They’re hangry.
Skibi tried the traditional methods of defending the castle (you know the ones). It didn’t work. So she came up with a better plan:

You don’t defeat enemies. You feed them.
Satisfy the appetites of the invaders with magical dessert-chefs, ridiculous cuisine combos, and maze layouts where every tile matters. Sweet treats, made fresh to heal the souls of the hangry horde.

What you do:
  • Build Mazes: Shape paths, trap lanes, and solve each stage with smart placement.
  • Draft Chefs by Cuisine: Pick a style, then add a second cuisine for wild combos.
  • Cook Up Synergies: Mix flavors for the ultimate “how is this working” food magic.
  • Chase Better Runs: Replay to optimize clear time, cost, and pathing.

A quick note from the kitchen:
SK2 is being rebuilt with modern tools by members of the original mod crew, with a new theme and a fresh art direction. Same maze brain, way more flavor.
